outcome: criterion validity of parent-reported gestational age
cohort: The study participants were primarily healthy children less than 6 years of age from TARGet Kids! in Toronto, Canada, linked with ICES administrative healthcare data.
finding: Parent-reported gestational age categories demonstrated high accuracy, with sensitivities ranging from 83.7% to 98.5% and specificities from 88.3% to 99.8%, showing minimal variation across various parent and socioeconomic factors.
followup_time: Less than 6 years (age of children at last observation)
